Θ统一采用本站的−iσyK约定；改成+iσyK只改变整体相位，不改变Θ²。: Throughout this site, Θ follows the −iσyK convention; using +iσyK changes only the overall phase, not Θ².
形式颜色振幅不自动成为电子自旋；数值相同或标签互换不能代替算符定义。: Formal color amplitudes do not automatically represent electron spin; equal numerical components or exchanged labels cannot replace an operator definition.
反幺正配对还要求Hamiltonian具有该对称；若讨论同一晶体动量，还须−k≡: Antiunitary pairing also requires the Hamiltonian to have that symmetry; pairing at the same crystal momentum additionally requires −k≡k. This experiment does not calculate bands.
所有精确字符串由有界有理输入的矩阵计算生成；浮点副本仅用于显示。: All exact strings are generated by matrix calculations on bounded rational inputs; floating-point copies are used only for display.
Θ=−iσyK；D(V)=wI−i(xσx+yσy+zσz)。选择一个明确SU(: Θ=−iσyK; D(V)=wI−i(xσx+yσy+zσz). One explicit SU(2) lift is chosen; the other differs by an overall factor of −1.
这里只计算自旋因子；没有空间轨道表示、Bloch平移相位或实际材料Hamilto: Only the spin factor is calculated here; spatial orbital representations, Bloch translation phases, and a material Hamiltonian are not included.
纯自旋操作：每个位置固定: Pure spin operation: every position is fixed
固定位置的纯自旋稳定子检验: Pure spin stabilizer test at fixed positions
磁矩是时间奇经典向量；W属于O(3)。旋量作用属于幺正/反幺正算符，两个作用空间: Magnetic moments are time-odd classical vectors, with W in O(3). Spinors transform under unitary or antiunitary operators; these two spaces of action must be distinguished.
只有逐点固定的正旋转才属于这里的幺正spin-only部分；等能磁畴旋转或方向置: Only proper rotations that fix every moment belong to the unitary spin-only part considered here; rotations between equal-energy magnetic domains or permutations of directions do not establish pointwise stabilization.
零、共线、共面和非共面由精确输入的秩区分；这里不对真实测量噪声作容差分类。: Zero, collinear, coplanar, and noncoplanar configurations are distinguished by the rank of the exact input; this experiment does not classify measured data using a noise tolerance.
本实验的场景是有限教学图案，不搜索完整自旋空间群，也不验证某个材料Hamilto: This experiment uses a finite teaching pattern; it neither searches for the full spin space group nor verifies a material Hamiltonian.
独立自旋操作与两种SOC锁定候选: Independent spin operation and two SOC-locked candidates
R使用正交笛卡尔坐标；不能直接把一般分数基底矩阵乘到笛卡尔磁矩上。: R is expressed in orthonormal Cartesian coordinates; a general matrix in a fractional-coordinate basis cannot be applied directly to Cartesian magnetic moments.
原U不等于任一锁定候选，不代表相同空间R,t配另一个U后也一定失败。: If the original U equals neither locked candidate, this does not imply that every other U combined with the same spatial R,t must also fail.
固定预设复用现有group_extensions的精确站点与联合生成元；不会改变: The fixed presets reuse exact sites and combined generators from the existing group_extensions module; results of the original experiments are unchanged.
空间模型包含任意整数平移；画面有限，不能把跨胞折回解释成完整空间操作恒等。: The spatial models include arbitrary integer translations; the display is finite, so wrapping across a cell boundary does not make the full spatial operation the identity.
量子实现只显示自旋因子；没有轨道表示、Bloch相位和Hamiltonian，不: The quantum implementation shows only the spin factor; without orbital representations, Bloch phases, and a Hamiltonian, it cannot establish degeneracy at the same k.
ZXQD0DQXZ 须为有限整数、十进制数或有理数，不接受符号表达式。: ZXQD0DQXZ must be a finite integer, decimal, or rational number; symbolic expressions are not accepted.
ZXQD0DQXZ 只接受有限十进制或 p/q，不接受函数、变量或任意表达式。: ZXQD0DQXZ accepts only finite decimals or p/q, not functions, variables, or arbitrary expressions.
ZXQD0DQXZ 超出精确教学输入的幅度或分母限制。: ZXQD0DQXZ exceeds the magnitude or denominator limit for exact teaching inputs.
ZXQD0DQXZ 须为 3×3 实矩阵。: ZXQD0DQXZ must be a real 3×3 matrix.
ZXQD0DQXZ 必须精确正交且行列式为 +1 或 −1。请用精确有理数而非舍: ZXQD0DQXZ must be exactly orthogonal with determinant +1 or −1. Use exact rational entries rather than a rounded rotation matrix.
复态不能是零向量。: The complex state cannot be the zero vector.
operatorPhase 不能为零；非零输入会规范化为单位模相位。: operatorPhase cannot be zero; a nonzero input is normalized to a phase of unit modulus.
先固定两个空间与有序基: First specify the two spaces and their ordered bases
P是形式标签空间的线性延拓；Θ作用于另一个明确指定的自旋1/2空间。相同二元坐标: P is the linear extension of label exchange in a formal label space; Θ acts on a separately specified spin-1/2 space. Equal two-component coordinates do not make the two physical spaces identical.
先共轭，再乘A: Conjugate first, then multiply by A
逐项显示ψ、ψ*和Aψ*，与只交换两个系数的Pψ比较。: Display ψ, ψ*, and Aψ* component by component, and compare them with Pψ, which only exchanges the two coefficients.
改变复系数检验线性: Vary a complex coefficient to test linearity
同时计算P(cψ)、cPψ、Θ(cψ)、c*Θψ及cΘψ。输入为实数时这一步可能: Calculate P(cψ), cPψ, Θ(cψ), c*Θψ, and cΘψ together. A real input may not distinguish the two transformation laws.
第二次作用仍要共轭: Conjugation is required on the second application too
逐次作用与算符复合独立核对。本约定A恰为实矩阵，但一般反幺正平方必须算AA*。: Check successive application independently against operator composition. A happens to be real in this convention, but the square of a general antiunitary operator requires AA*.
算符整体相位与二次作用: Overall operator phase and repeated application
将Θ乘以单位模相位不会改变平方；反线性使第二个相位被共轭，不能误算成相位平方。: Multiplying Θ by a phase of unit modulus does not change its square; antilinearity conjugates the second phase factor, so the result must not be computed using the phase squared.
相同分量与相同物理射线分开: Distinguish equal components from the same physical ray
ψc上Pψc与Θψc可能完全相同；ψ+上则正交。整体负号不改变孤立态概率，输出内: Pψc and Θψc may be identical for ψc, whereas they are orthogonal for ψ+. An overall minus sign does not change the probabilities of an isolated state; output inner products and Bloch vectors help distinguish genuinely different rays.
保持换色不强制简并: Color-exchange symmetry does not force degeneracy
精确H=σx保持P，却有两个不简并能级±1；它不保持Θ，因此不违反Kramers: The exact H=σx preserves P but has two nondegenerate levels ±1; it does not preserve Θ and therefore does not violate Kramers' theorem.
给Θ加整体相位不改变平方: An overall phase on Θ does not change its square
换色反例不具有Θ对称: The color-exchange counterexample lacks Θ symmetry
只有SO(3)正旋转可作本实验的SU(2)提升。: Only proper rotations in SO(3) admit the SU(2) lift used in this experiment.
提供operation矩阵时须选operationPreset=custom。: Set operationPreset=custom when providing an operation matrix.
本实验空间部分严格为恒等，不能把磁矩换到另一个站点后再宣布spin-only成立: The spatial part is strictly the identity in this experiment; moving a magnetic moment to another site does not establish a spin-only symmetry.
Wm_i=m_i 对每个i；空间R=I,t=0: Wm_i=m_i for every i; spatial R=I,t=0
从真实磁矩求秩和张成空间: Calculate the rank and span from the actual magnetic moments
用精确RREF找独立磁矩，显示正交归一的张成基与正交补。: Use exact RREF to identify independent magnetic moments, and display orthonormal bases for their span and its orthogonal complement.
只允许正交补内自由变化: Allow freedom only within the orthogonal complement
W逐点固定张成空间，在其正交补上可取任意正交变换。这给出完整族，不是用有限几个采: W fixes the span pointwise and can act as any orthogonal transformation on its orthogonal complement. This gives the entire family; continuity is not inferred from a finite set of samples.
逐个磁矩乘矩阵并比较: Apply the matrix to each magnetic moment and compare
并排显示W、m_i、Wm_i和Wm_i−m_i。共面三角的C₃可置换三个方向，却: Show W, m_i, Wm_i, and Wm_i−m_i side by side. A C₃ operation on a coplanar triangle can permute the three directions, but it does not fix them pointwise at fixed sites.
把经典不正变换解释为反幺正: Interpret a classical improper transformation as an antiunitary action
detW=−1时先写V=−W∈SO(3)，再给出D(V)Θ；绝不把不正3×3矩阵: For detW=−1, first write V=−W∈SO(3), then construct D(V)Θ; an improper 3×3 matrix is never identified directly with a unitary spinor rotation.
经典平方与旋量平方分开计算: Calculate the classical and spinor squares separately
并列显示W²与自旋因子的平方。反幺正部分必须算BB*，而不是B²；完整空间算符及: Show W² beside the square of the spin factor. For the antiunitary part, calculate BB* rather than B²; the full spatial operator and momentum conditions have not been calculated.
(BK)²=BB*；D(V)²另保留双覆盖中心负号: (BK)²=BB*; D(V)² separately retains the central minus sign of the double cover
所选W精确正交: The selected W is exactly orthogonal
张成基与补空间正交完整: The span and complement bases form a complete orthonormal basis
张成空间投影保持全部磁矩: Projection onto the span preserves all magnetic moments
逐点检验与矩阵残差一致: Pointwise tests agree with the matrix residuals
旋量作用保持范数: The spinor action preserves the norm
固定同一个空间操作与磁畴: Keep the same spatial operation and magnetic domain
先列出笛卡尔R、t和原独立自旋矩阵U，保留原操作的身份。: First list Cartesian R, t, and the original independent spin matrix U, keeping the identity of the original operation explicit.
逐点找同种目标站点: Find a target site of the same species for each source site
只有空间位置和化学标签先匹配，才比较变换后的磁矩；周期例按整格平移匹配，未折回位: Compare transformed magnetic moments only after matching spatial positions and chemical labels; periodic examples match modulo integer lattice translations while retaining the unwrapped positions.
从极向量转到时间奇轴矢量: From polar-vector rotation to a time-odd axial-vector action
逐站点显示Rm、det(R)Rm以及最后的时间反演符号，而非只给最终通过/失败。: For every site, show Rm, det(R)Rm, and the final time-reversal sign, alongside the resulting pass/fail test.
检查原来的U是否满足锁定: Check whether the original U satisfies locking
分别比较原U与两候选矩阵，区分原操作失去锁定和另一个候选仍保持图案。: Compare the original U with each candidate matrix, distinguishing failure of locking for the original operation from preservation of the pattern by another candidate.
重新检验两种候选的图案匹配: Retest pattern matching for both candidates
即便候选不等于原U，它也可能是另一个实际保磁图案的操作；共线半平移可由Θ补偿。: A candidate different from the original U may still define another operation that preserves the magnetic pattern; Θ can compensate a half translation in a collinear pattern.
保留幺正与反幺正的区别: Keep unitary and antiunitary actions distinct
ε=1候选对应自旋旋转加Θ，给出自旋因子的精确实现与平方；这还不是完整轨道/平移: The ε=1 candidate combines a spin rotation with Θ. Its exact spin factor and square are given; this is not yet the full orbital/translation operator.
结构匹配不替代Hamiltonian对称: Structural matching does not establish Hamiltonian symmetry
本计算不输入或检验实际SOC Hamiltonian，也不由净磁矩为零宣布能带简: This calculation neither takes an actual SOC Hamiltonian as input nor tests one; zero net magnetization alone is not used to infer band degeneracy or Kramers pairing.
图案匹配 + 锁定 + 具体Hamiltonian检验，层次不同: Pattern matching + locking + a specific Hamiltonian test are distinct levels of analysis

输入自旋矩阵精确正交: The input spin matrix is exactly orthogonal
两候选的det分别为+1和−1: The two candidates have determinants +1 and −1, respectively
两个时间分支是不同矩阵: The two time-reversal branches are distinct matrices
每个候选由所有站点逐项检验: Every candidate is tested site by site across all sites
